title: ExportJobDetailsResponse
description: Response for checking the status of an export job.

jobId.description: Unique identifier for the export job.

jobCode.description:
Numeric code indicating the job status.

Possible values:
- `1001`: JOB NOT INITIATED
- `1002`: JOB IN PROGRESS
- `1003`: ERROR OCCURRED
- `1004`: JOB COMPLETED
- `1005`: JOB NOT FOUND

jobStatus.description: Human-readable status message describing the current job state.

downloadUrl.description: URL to download the exported data after job completion.

expiryTime.description: Epoch timestamp indicating when the download URL will expire (in milliseconds).
